desktopPersistence.canonicalPaymentStatus: stored separately from fiscal and receipt status
desktopPersistence.fiscalIssuanceState: stored separately from payment and receipt status
desktopPersistence.authoritativePresentation: stored as opaque POS Server-owned presentation snapshot
desktopPersistence.semanticRequestHash: stored when Central PMS returns recorded fiscal semantic evidence
desktopPersistence.retryable: stored from safe Central PMS error responses
desktopPersistence.nextRetryAt: terminal-local retry guidance, never a fabricated server timestamp
desktopPersistence.correlationId: Central PMS response correlation retained separately from terminal request correlation

authoritativePresentation.persistencePosture: APT stores the complete returned payload as an opaque authoritative snapshot for restart-safe display.
notes: APT must not reconstruct lines, totals, taxes, tenders, fiscal numbers, wording, template content, or presentation content.
APT must not substitute placeholders or local cash-summary fields for missing authoritative Sales Invoice fields.
APT must not mark the receipt printed, reprinted, emailed, or delivered in this slice.
